turn.history_content:
Pets are not allowed on trails, including the Vernal Fall trail, even when carried. [Pets - Yosemite National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/yose/planyourvisit/pets.htm)

The Wawona Meadow Loop is an exception where pets are allowed. [Pets - Yosemite National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/yose/planyourvisit/pets.htm)

Pets are allowed on paved trails including Bridalveil Fall and Lower Yosemite Fall, unless signs prohibit them. [Pets - Yosemite National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/yose/planyourvisit/pets.htm)

Pets may use the paved Cook’s Meadow trail and boardwalks, but not the unpaved trail around Mirror Lake. [Pets - Yosemite National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/yose/planyourvisit/pets.htm)

Keep Your Pet Safe

Wildlife can pose a threat to pets in Yosemite, both directly and indirectly. Keeping your pet attended and on a six-foot leash as well as fully vaccinated will reduce the chances of injury or disease. Rabies and distemper have been detected in park wildlife.
